shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && echo "---" && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50

echo "=== App.tsx ===" && cat src/App.tsx && echo "=== main.tsx ===" && cat src/main.tsx && echo "=== index.html ===" && cat index.html && echo "=== vite.config.ts ===" && cat vite.config.ts && echo "=== tsconfig ===" && cat tsconfig.json && echo "=== run.mjs ===" && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs && echo "=== installed uikit version ===" && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep -E '"version"|"main"|"module"|"types"' && echo "=== git log ===" && git log --oneline -5

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && ls $U/components/theme/ && echo "=== theme index ===" && cat $U/components/theme/index.d.ts && echo "=== types ===" && cat $U/components/theme/types.d.ts && echo "=== ThemeProvider ===" && cat $U/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts && echo "=== hooks ===" && for f in $U/components/theme/use*.d.ts $U/components/theme/getThemeType.d.ts $U/components/theme/ThemeContext.d.ts $U/components/theme/ThemeSettingsContext.d.ts; do echo "--- $f"; cat "$f"; done

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && echo "=== ThemeProvider.js ===" && cat $U/components/theme/ThemeProvider.js && echo "=== dom-helpers ===" && cat $U/components/theme/dom-helpers.js && echo "=== components available ===" && ls $U/components | tr '\n' ' ' && echo && echo "=== icons pkg? ===" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && echo "=== Switch props ===" && cat $U/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts && cat $U/components/Controls/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60 && echo "=== SegmentedRadioGroup ===" && cat $U/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60 && echo "=== npm latest ===" && timeout 20 npm view @gravity-ui/uikit version dist-tags 2>&1 | head -5

mkdir -p /tmp/uikit8 && cd /tmp/uikit8 && timeout 90 npm pack @gravity-ui/uikit@8.0.0 --silent 2>&1 | tail -1 && tar -xzf gravity-ui-uikit-8.0.0.tgz && echo "=== v8 theme index ===" && cat package/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts && echo "=== v8 types ===" && cat package/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts && echo "=== v8 ThemeProvider ===" && cat package/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts && echo "=== v8 useTheme ===" && cat package/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts && echo "=== v8 CHANGELOG 8.0.0 breaking ===" && awk '/^## \[8\.0\.0\]/{p=1} p&&/^## \[7\./{exit} p' package/CHANGELOG.md | head -120

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && V8=/tmp/uikit8/package/build/esm && echo "=== icons pkg ===" && grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | head -5 && grep -lE '^(Sun|Moon|Display)\b' -r node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -E "Sun|Moon|Display" node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -20 && echo "=== Icon.d.ts (v7) ===" && cat $U/components/Icon/Icon.d.ts && echo "=== Button.d.ts (v7) ===" && sed -n '1,60p' $U/components/Button/Button.d.ts && echo "=== ControlProps v7 ===" && grep -n -A12 'interface ControlProps' $U/components/types.d.ts && echo "=== deprecated markers v7 ===" && grep -rl '@deprecated' $U/components/{Switch,Button,Icon,SegmentedRadioGroup,Text,Card,RadioButton} 2>/dev/null; grep -rn '@deprecated' $U/components/index.d.ts $U/components/RadioButton/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head && echo "=== v8 components ===" && ls $V8/components | tr '\n' ' ' && echo && echo "=== v8 Switch ===" && cat $V8/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts && echo "=== v8 Icon ===" && cat $V8/components/Icon/Icon.d.ts && echo "=== v8 Button props head ===" && sed -n '1,50p' $V8/components/Button/Button.d.ts && echo "=== v8 SegmentedRadioGroup ===" && cat $V8/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts && echo "=== v8 package root ===" && ls /tmp/uikit8/package && grep -n '"react"' -A2 /tmp/uikit8/package/package.json | head

grep -n -A8 '"dependencies"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -12 && grep -n -A3 '"peerDependencies"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json && echo "=== g-root css ===" && grep -o '\.g-root{[^}]*}' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -3; grep -o 'body{[^}]*}' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -2; grep -rn "g-root\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/*.css | head -5 && echo "=== Card/Text d.ts ===" && grep -n "view?\|type?\|size?\|theme?" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head && grep -n "variant?\|color?" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -4 && echo "=== Flex ===" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/ && echo "=== @types/react version ===" && grep '"version"' node_modules/@types/react/package.json && ls node_modules | grep -iE 'jsdom|testing-library' || echo "no jsdom/testing-library"

(which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/.bin 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'playwright|puppeteer'; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null) || echo "no browser"; echo "=== gitignore ===" && cat .gitignore && echo "=== lock sync ===" && timeout 90 npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tail -3 && grep -c '"node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons"' package-lock.json && echo "=== git status ===" && git status --short
sed -i "s/g-root_theme-dark/g-root_theme_dark/" src/theme/ThemeSwitcher.test.tsx && npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -8 && rm -rf dist && git status --short && git diff --stat
